pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English - quickly develop your conversational ability
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversational English Lessons are going to help you improve your English language skills through engaging, challenging and enjoyable conversations. 

* Wide variety of topics: We will talk about a range of topics, including poetry, movies, news and politics, conspiracies, history, and more. You can choose or find the topics that interest you most and improve your language skills while having fun.

* Vocabulary development: During our conversations, you'll be introduced to new vocabulary words and phrases that will help you express yourself more effectively in English. I will help you understand the meanings of these new words and show you how to use them in different contexts.

* Grammar corrections: I will provide you with immediate written feedback on any grammar mistakes you make during the conversation. This feedback will help you learn the correct grammar usage in a relaxed and natural way.

* Phrasal verbs: Phrasal verbs are an important part of the English language. During our conversations, you'll learn how to use them in context and improve your understanding of their meanings.

* Fun and engaging: Lessons should first and foremost be enjoyable and engaging, with a focus on conversation. You'll have plenty of opportunities to practice your speaking and listening skills, and to learn new vocabulary and grammar in a relaxed and supportive environment. 

I believe that the best way to learn a language is through conversation and by having fun, and the Conversational English Lessons provide the perfect platform to do just that.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn English through the art of photography
pro_course_detail.description:
The exploration of photography offers the perfect medium to develop vocabulary and creative English usage:
1. Expand your vocabulary: Photography has its own set of technical terms and jargon that can help you improve your English vocabulary.
2. Improve your reading and comprehension skills: As you learn about different photography styles and techniques, you'll be exposed to new vocabulary and grammatical structures, helping you to develop your understanding of the language.
3. Develop cultural awareness: By learning about the cultural background of photography, you'll gain insights into the different ways that cultures view the world and learn to appreciate and respect diversity.
4. Enhance your listening and speaking abilities: Through active engagement in conversations with your teacher and classmates, you'll practice your English communication skills and learn how to express your ideas and opinions in a clear and concise way.
5. Explore new perspectives: Photography is an art form that encourages self-expression, and by combining this with English language learning, you can express yourself in new and exciting ways.

The course is designed to run over 5 or 10 sessions and is tailored to your specific area of interest. We can work with you to create a personalized learning plan that meets your needs and helps you achieve your language learning goals.

The course provides a unique and engaging way to improve your English language skills and explore the world of photography. With benefits such as expanding your vocabulary, improving your reading and comprehension skills, developing cultural awareness, enhancing your listening and speaking abilities, and exploring new perspectives, you'll gain a comprehensive understanding of both the language and the art form.  Try the “Learn English through Photography" course, we offer a 30-minute sample class, and get a visual taster today!

pro_course_detail.title: Being English
pro_course_detail.description:
The “Being English" class is designed to help you explore the rich culture and modern history of England and the British Isles. The classes will educate and inform you about the different cultural aspects of being English, and what it means to be British.

The classes will a range of topics that highlight the unique characteristics of England and the British Isles. For example:
* British traditions and customs: From afternoon tea to Guy Fawkes Night, we'll explore the unique traditions and customs that make up the British way of life.
* Historical events: We'll delve into the modern history of England and the British Isles, examining significant events such as the Industrial Revolution, the World Wars, and more.
* Famous English figures: We'll discuss the lives and legacies of some of England's most famous figures, such as William Shakespeare, Queen Elizabeth II, and David Bowie.
* English language and dialects: We'll examine the nuances of the English language, including regional dialects and slang, and how language use is an important aspect of being English.
* Controversies and chaos: We’ll talk about the Empire and the remnants of it.

The classes are designed to be interactive and engaging, with a focus on discussion and exploration. You'll have the opportunity to learn from an experienced teacher who is passionate about sharing his knowledge and insights into English culture and history.

Through these classes you'll gain a deeper understanding of what it means to be English and British, and you'll be equipped with the knowledge and skills to navigate the unique cultural landscape of England and the British Isles.

Let’s travel to Little Britain together.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice - Become more confident!
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversation is the best way to practice your speaking and listening skills in English. In this class, we will practice conversations based on random topics. If you do not wish to choose random topics, you can bring topics to the class or message me before lessons if there is something in particular that you would like to practice.

To decide the topics, a random topic will be selected from a list. If you do not like the topic, a different one can be selected. However, practicing conversation on whatever the topic is a great way for you to test your listening and speaking abilities in English!

I also send out some articles and videos every 1-2 weeks, which gives us a topic for discussion in the class. Normally, one of these will be a topic for debate as I believe that it is a really good way to practice your language skills!

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar class
pro_course_detail.description:
In these lessons, we will cover grammar concepts and test your knowledge on their use. The grammar can either be taught in a way to increase your fluency, or I am able to teach you the syntax explanation and the linguistics that explain the concept.

Grammar can be difficult for many of us to learn, but it doesn't always have to be boring! I make sure that we are doing exercises and getting you actively involved in your own learning so that you can have a much easier time when studying grammar.

IMPORTANT: Please contact me before booking this class as I will need to know your level, goals for learning English, and how you would like to learn grammar before the session.

pro_course_detail.title: General English Skills (Writing, Reading, Speaking, Listening)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, we will practice speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills that we be based on the level of English that you are at. This class is closer to the more traditional teaching of a classroom, where you will be given material in the lesson, then homework after classes. This will include quizzes and tests to prepare you for any assessments that you may have.

IELTS focused classes, where we can learn about taking the test and practicing your language skills for this, are also included in this class. Please make sure to let me know about what topic you would like to practice before you book the class!

There is a wide range of topics available, so you learn all kinds of new skills and vocabulary!

pro_course_detail.title: Accent/Pronunciation class - Speaking like a native! - Dialect coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to learn to speak with a British accent? Would you like to know how to achieve more native pronunciation? Would you like to learn more about pronunciation and accents?

This is my favourite class to teach, where I really get to put my linguistics background to good use. If you take this class, you can expect an introduction to linguistic terms and to phonetic transcription, but it will not be the only focus of our class.

I speak English with a neutral southern accent, which you have likely heard in TV shows and movies. If this is something you would like to achieve in your English, this may be the class for you. For these classes, I use my knowledge of phonetics (part of my degree) and experience working with students from around the world to aid in your accent development. There is the added option of learning the IPA chart and how this may help you learn other accents or dialects.

Please contact me before booking this class so I can assess whether this is the right class for you!

I look forward to seeing you in class :)

I have taught a wide range of language learners of all levels and nationalities, privately, in schools and universities, in companies, summer camps and one-to-one. 

I have been a Cambridge oral examiner and have taught FCE, CAE and CPE with excellent exam results. I was also an Assistant Director of Studies in Poland, where I provided support, training and observation of teachers. I have taught in-company Business English classes for CEOs and administrative staff and English for Tourism when I lived in San Diego and Barcelona.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I want to help you improve your CONFIDENCE and FLUENCY. The best part of my job is seeing you achieve your goals and progress in lessons that are enjoyable and focused on your needs.  

In our first lesson, we will spend time talking about your goals. We will talk about what you would like to learn and improve and why you need or want to improve your English. Then together, we will work towards those goals in lessons that are designed around your individual, specific needs.

Every student is different, so our lessons can be structured in different ways but will always contain a lot of speaking practice and will focus on both fluency and accuracy.

pro_course_detail.title: General Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:

We can use articles that you have read as a basis for conversation or questions based around a specific topic. We can focus on subjects you feel comfortable talking about or topics that stretch your abilities. There will be lots of conversation! 

I don't want to stop the flow of the conversation, so during our discussions, I will write down any errors as you talk and towards the end of the lesson I will write each error in the chat box so we can focus together on the corrections. I have found this a very successful way to deal with pronunciation, grammar and vocabulary corrections and you also have a record to look back on after the lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: ⚖️ Legal English [Improve Your English Through Legal Topics]
pro_course_detail.description:
📝 What is the Legal English course?
This course helps you improve your English by learning and talking about legal topics. You will build vocabulary, practise reading, listening, and speaking, and learn to understand legal ideas in English. You do not need to be a lawyer – just an interest in law is enough!

🗂 Course Options
Choose the best level for your goals and experience:

🔹 Legal English (B1–B2)
For learners who want to improve their professional English through legal topics. Each unit includes four content lessons and one review class. You will study areas such as copyright, contracts, and government regulation, using videos, texts, and vocabulary practice.

🔹 Legal English (B2–C1)
For law students, legal professionals, or advanced learners. This course explores six areas of law: Family, Criminal, Labour, International and Human Rights, Environmental, and Corporate Law. Each unit includes four topic lessons and one revision class, with real cases, interviews, and discussions.

🎯 Who is it for?
🎓 Level: B1–C1
👤 Ages 16 and above
💼 Good for: Law students, legal professionals, or learners interested in legal topics in English

ℹ️ Additional Notes
⚠️ This course does not prepare you for a legal exam or qualification
⏱ All lessons include a 5-minute break – longer breaks available if needed

📨 Interested?
Send me a message to ask questions or choose the best level before your first class.

pro_course_detail.title: 🗣️ Speak English [Beyond the Basics]
pro_course_detail.description:
📝 What is the Speak English course?
This course helps you move beyond simple grammar and vocabulary so you can have more interesting and confident conversations in English. You'll learn to express your thoughts clearly, talk about exciting topics, and respond naturally – just like in real life.

🌍 We’ll explore culture, current events, and global issues using real videos, articles, and interviews. Lessons are focused on real-world English, critical thinking, and expressing your opinions.

🗂 What will we do in class?
🔹 Discuss thought-provoking topics in English
🔹 Watch and listen to authentic videos and audio
🔹 Learn practical vocabulary and natural expressions
🔹 Build fluency through guided conversation and feedback

🎯 Who is it for?
🎓 Level: B1–C1
👤 Ages 16 and above
💬 Good for: Learners who already know the basics and want to speak more fluently and confidently for work, travel, or study

🙅‍♂️ This course is not for you if:
🔴 You are a complete beginner
🔴 You want to focus mainly on grammar rules
🔴 You are preparing for a specific English exam

ℹ️ Additional Notes
🗣 Lessons focus on real-life English and confident communication
🕐 All lessons include a 5-minute break – longer breaks available if needed

📨 Ready to begin?
Send me a message to tell me about your goals and we’ll choose the best approach together.

pro_course_detail.title: 🌍 General English [Develop Your Everyday English Skills]
pro_course_detail.description:
📝 What is the General English course?
This course helps you improve your English for everyday life. You will learn to speak more fluently, understand spoken English more easily, and feel more confident using English in real situations. Lessons include a mix of speaking, listening, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation – always taught through interesting, real-life topics. The focus is on communication, not textbooks.

🗂 Course Options
Choose the level that best fits your current skills and goals:

🔹 Intermediate (B1–B2)
This level is for learners who want to become more confident and comfortable using English in everyday conversations. You’ll talk about topics such as daily life, travel, work, entertainment, and current events. You’ll also practise useful grammar and expand your vocabulary in a natural way, with lots of speaking practice and guided support.

🔹 Upper-Intermediate (B2–C1)
This level is for students who already have a good level of English and want to go further. You’ll explore more complex grammar and vocabulary while talking about engaging topics like culture, technology, lifestyle, and global issues. There’s a strong focus on fluency, accuracy, and expressing ideas clearly and naturally in discussions.

🎯 Who is it for?
🎓 Level: B1–C1
👤 Ages 16 and above
💬 Good for: Learners who want to improve communication skills, build vocabulary, and speak more naturally and confidently

ℹ️ Additional Notes
⏱ All lessons include a 5-minute break – longer breaks available if needed

📨 Interested?

pro_course_detail.title: 🎥 English Through Video [Real Topics, Real Language]
pro_course_detail.description:
📝 What is the English Through Video course?
This course helps you improve your English by watching and talking about real videos. You’ll hear natural English, learn useful words and phrases, and build confidence in speaking. Lessons are based on short clips from interviews, talks, and documentaries. They’re interesting, modern, and made for real people – not textbooks.

🗂 Course Options
Pick the level that feels right for you:

🔹 Upper-Intermediate (B2–C1)
Great if you want to feel more confident when speaking and listening. Topics include everyday life, society, science, and culture. Each lesson gives you new vocabulary, listening practice, and time to share your ideas in guided conversation.

🔹 Advanced (C1–C2)
Perfect if you already speak English well and want to go deeper. You’ll watch more challenging videos on psychology, global issues, and abstract topics, and practise expressing opinions clearly and naturally in discussions. Expect to explore a wide range of vocabulary, including idioms and expressions.

🎯 Who is it for?
🎓 Level: B2–C2
👤 Ages 16 and above
💬 Good for: Learners who want to understand real spoken English and talk about interesting, modern topics in a natural way

ℹ️ Additional Notes
🎧 Every lesson includes listening practice, conversation time, and vocabulary input

pro_course_detail.title: 💼 Business English [Language for Work, Success & Growth]
pro_course_detail.description:
📝 What is the Business English course?
This course helps you improve your English for the workplace. You’ll learn how to speak more clearly, write more professionally, and feel more confident using English in real business situations. Lessons focus on useful language for meetings, emails, calls, teamwork, and presentations – all taught through practical, real-world topics. Whether you're just starting your career or already experienced, this course will help you grow.

🗂 Course Options
Choose the level that fits your current English and experience:

🔹 Pre-Intermediate (A2–B1)
Start building your business English with the basics. Learn to introduce yourself, describe your job, write simple emails, and take part in everyday workplace conversations.

🔹 Intermediate (B1–B2)
Gain confidence in common business situations such as meetings, customer service, and teamwork. Learn useful expressions and grammar in context while practising real communication.

🔹 Upper-Intermediate (B2–C1)
Take your skills further with more advanced tasks like giving presentations, writing reports, or leading discussions. Improve your vocabulary, fluency, and accuracy.

🔹 Advanced/Proficiency (C1–C2)
Work on fluency, precision, and style. You’ll explore topics like leadership, innovation, and international business while learning to communicate clearly and naturally at a high level.

🎯 Who is it for?
🎓 Level: A2–C2
👤 Ages 18 and above
💬 Good for: Professionals, job seekers, or students preparing for work or study in English

ℹ️ Additional Notes
🗣 Lessons include speaking, listening, vocabulary, grammar, and writing
⏱ All lessons include a 5-minute break – longer breaks available if needed

📨 Interested?

pro_course_detail.title: 📘 Step-by-Step English [Learn with a Coursebook]
pro_course_detail.description:
📝 What is the Step-by-Step English course?
This course is perfect if you enjoy working with a clear structure. We’ll follow a well-designed English coursebook, step by step, so you can build your skills with confidence. Lessons include grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, and plenty of speaking – all organised around clear goals and useful topics. You’ll always know what we’re working on and why, with regular review and practice to help everything stick.

🗂 Coursebook Options
You can choose from the following textbooks, depending on your level, interests, and how you like to learn:

🔹 Speakout 3rd Edition (Pearson) – A1 to C2
A modern, real-life English course with video, listening, speaking and grammar. Great if you want to focus on everyday communication.

🔹 English File 4th Edition (Oxford) – A1 to C2
A clear and balanced course that builds all key skills, with extra focus on pronunciation and grammar. Ideal for steady, all-round progress.

🔹 Reading for the Real World (Compass) – A1 to C1
A reading-based course using real-world texts to develop vocabulary, reading skills, and critical thinking. Perfect for more academic learners or those preparing for university.

🎯 Who is it for?
🎓 Level: A1–C2
👤 Ages 14 and above
💬 Good for: Learners who like structure, want clear progress, or enjoy textbook-based learning

pro_course_detail.description:
Join me on a musical adventure! We will listen to, and discuss, Rolling Stones, through Black Sabbath, Sex Pistols and Oasis, but we will also go much deeper into British music, uncovering hidden gems and secrets. 

We will also move onto more contemporary music and a snapshot of the UK nowadays.

Learn about British rock 'n' roll, punk, heavy metal - but not only! British music also has its own styles of reggae, hip hop and electronic music, which can teach us a lot about the current state of the nation. Music is also an insight into the culture of the time, so fashions, society and even politics will be included in our conversations.

We will listen to personally curated and tailored playlists, study lyrics and consider what this meant for UK culture at the time and now. 

Expect to learn vocabulary for describing likes and likes (going beyond "I like" and "I don't like"), different adjectives for songs (more than "good" and "bad"), as well as practising conditionals ("if I go, there will be trouble"), and a variety of verb tenses that come up while listening to music ("I used to listen to music like this", "I have never heard anything like this before").

Higher levels (B1+) will watch match highlights and discuss the hot topics of the day in both the mainstream media and social media. We will discover and analyse the rich tapestry of football idioms and expressions, and put the beautiful game into historical perspective of more than 150 years of English football.
